title: Socket Programming in Python (Guide)
description: Build a Python socket server and client from scratch, then extend it to handle multiple connections at once without blocking.
summary: Socket programming is essential for network communication, enabling data exchange across different devices. In Python, sockets allow for inter-process communication (IPC) over networks.
takeaways: By the end of this tutorial, you’ll understand that: A socket in Python is an endpoint for sending or receiving data across a network using the socket API.
